description: Paint along a path on the active layer with a painting or retouching tool, using that tool's current brush and options (Paths panel > Stroke Path). Give a path from the Paths panel or points for a temporary one. Set the brush first with set_tool_options. Clone Stamp and Healing Brush need cloneSource

cloneSource.description: Clone Stamp and Healing Brush: where to sample from, as Alt-clicking does

layer.description: Layer to sample. Default the active layer

closed.description: With points: close the temporary path. Default false

path.description: Name of a path in the Paths panel

points.description: Instead of path: corners of a temporary path, [[x, y], ...] in pixels. It is removed afterwards

simulatePressure.description: Taper the stroke as if drawn with a pressure-sensitive pen. Default false

name: stroke_path
title: Stroke Path
